name: Slayer Bow Master
body:
Many think themselves masters of bow combat, but few implement the skill to the level of the bow master.

Close Archery (Ex)

At 2nd level, a bow master is ready to fight in tight quarters and can make a ranged attack in melee with a bow without provoking attacks of opportunity against a studied target. At 6th level, the bow master gains Snap Shot as a bonus feat, usable with any bow they are wielding. At 10th level this becomes Improved Snap Shot. The bow master need not meet the prerequisites of either bonus feat.

This ability replaces slayer talents gained at 2nd, 6th and 10th levels.

Archer’s Sneak Attack (Ex or Su)

Beginning with 3rd level, bow master’s sneak attack deals damage in d8s rather than d6s when using a bow. Sneak attacks with all other weapons use d4s instead.

This ability alters sneak attack.

Deadly Arrow (Ex)

A bow master can take a full round action to make a ranged attack against a studied target within 120 ft that they can see. At the end of this action the bow master makes an attack at their highest base attack bonus. If this attack hits it deals damage normally. Then subtract 5 from the attack roll and compare to the target’s AC, if the new total would hit the attack deals damage again. Repeat this process until subtracting 5 from the total would result in a miss.

Each instance of damage caused by this attack deals additional damage for feats, special abilities, and other bonuses which are not additional dice and can each apply on-hit effects such as poison. Only the first attack can apply precision damage or is multiplied on a critical hit.

This ability replaces stalker.

Master of the Bow (Ex)

At 20th level the bow master cannot be disarmed of a bow they are carrying and it cannot be sundered. In addition they treat all bows as though they had a critical threat range of 19-20, this stacks with Improved Critical or the keen magic weapon property. Whenever the bow master confirms a critical hit against a studied target, they increase the critical multiplier of the attack by 1.

This ability replaces master slayer.
